name: Scento Perfume Database (2026-10-29)
revision_signature: unsigned; identity is established by the official publisher repository and its links, not a cryptographic commit signature
access_basis: The publisher Scento publicly distributes this offline dataset under CC BY 4.0 in its Scento-com/perfume-dataset repository. This permission covers the exported dataset, separately from live API terms.
approval_basis: Project stage 0 permits this publisher-authorized offline CC BY 4.0 snapshot. The pinned LICENSE and publisher README confirm reuse with Scento attribution, a license link and a statement of changes. No site scraping, live API calls, photos or review texts are authorized by this manifest.
approval_timestamp_meaning: Local verification of the public license and project offline-import decision; not a separate private permission or upstream publication timestamp.
observed_at_meaning: Time the pinned artifact was downloaded. The publisher does not provide a per-row observation timestamp; this is not the time each perfume was checked or its popularity measured.
attribution: Scento — https://www.scento.com/perfume-database · CC BY 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ · Changes in the MVP: selection and field normalization.
provenance: Publisher policy: facts are checked against perfume-house pages and authorized retailers; descriptions are written by Scento; third-party source texts are not included. Each exported record carries its own public Scento URL.
revision_note: The 2026-10-29 data commit contains stale README snapshot/citation dates. The following README-only commit 086769ecf1add770ea6646bd4d88d39f0e7cddeb corrects these dates to 2026-10-29; the data commit message explicitly identifies the release and 1479 perfumes.
changes: Bundled upstream perfumes.jsonl and LICENSE bytes are unchanged.
Runtime adapter selects up to 300 records ordered by the original external id.
Runtime adapter maps fields to frozen contracts; empty perfumers and missing year remain unknown, and notes not assigned to a verified pyramid level remain unspecified.
Original id, url and popularity_rank remain attributable to this snapshot. Popularity is not a user rating or review score.
